posts.cooked:
More lore-based conjecture:

The quotes on the Ennead cards "Rise to Power" and "Sun's Fury" are from Ra: God of the Sun #289, while the quote from Ra's "Solar Flare" is from #290. Ra is not yet Horus of Two Horizons on Solar Flare, so this must be during the "massive battle" mentioned. 

Apart from Anubis' nemesis symbol, the only card linking the Ennead and The Tomb of Anubis might be "Taste of Immortality," which depicts Osiris and a beaten Ra (pre-Horus) inside a tomb-like room of some sort. However, the grail theme of "Taste of Immortality" isn't very Egyptian.  This may have been before Ra encountered the full Ennead.

Just unlocked Ra!

Fighting The Ennead in the Tomb of Anubis with a Team of Ra, AA, Vis, & NM (in the order) - 7 of the Ennead got out of the Shrine during the game.

Conditions:

1) Ra was last hero standing

2) He was Incapped by damage dealt by the Ennead (Geb's melee attack)

2) He had all 9 of his ongoings/equipment in play (plus an extra Flesh of the Sun God & Wrathful Gaze that snuck in).  

3) He did not have either of the Tomb's Treasures (neither were in play)

As stated elsewhere, the problem is you can't have both Solar Flare & Imbued Fire in play at the end of Ra's turn, so I had Incapped NM play the Solar Flare for him while he was at low HP. (AA, Vis, & NM were also helpful in finding all of 8 of Ra's ongoing cards and getting them into play)
